name: ahrefs_backlinks_stats
description: Live Ahrefs backlink overview (live / all-time backlinks and referring domains) — not a full backlink export.

name: ahrefs_connection_status
description: Whether the brand has a connected Ahrefs account (host / target / last-four only — never the API key). No connect or disconnect tool on this surface.

name: ahrefs_domain_rating
description: Live Ahrefs Domain Rating and Ahrefs Rank for a target domain or URL. Site Explorer overview only.

name: ahrefs_organic_keywords
description: Live Ahrefs organic-keyword rows for a target. Default limit 10; values above 50 are refused (Nexus hard cap).

name: analyze_brand
description: Gather brand evidence from the web and save a marketing-plan draft (no steps). Optional website_url is fetched.

name: cancel_marketing_plan_run
description: Cancel a queued or running marketing-plan run. Finished steps are kept. Destructive for remaining pending work.

name: check_reporting_data_available
description: Which dates and paid-media channels have analytics data for a brand before querying metrics. An empty metrics result outside this coverage is missing data, not a zero. Stay on the same brand_id.

name: clone_video_pre_assessment
description: Clone-video questionnaire and disclaimers for generate_new_clone_video_ad. Pass a video_url from list_ad_instance_items only. Relay questions and disclaimers. Stop if status is nsfw-error.

name: clone_voice
description: Clone a speaker sample into a brand voice. Confirm the speaker consented first. Required: brand_id, voice_url. Optional name. Synchronous — returns voice_id; do not poll get_generation_status. Costs credits.

name: connect_openai_ads
description: Connect OpenAI Ads with the brand's API key. The key is forwarded once and never logged or returned. OpenAI Ads has no OAuth URL.

name: connect_posthog
description: Connect a PostHog project with a personal API key (phx_…, not phc_…). The key needs both Project:Read and Query:Read; a Query:Read-only key is rejected. Host must be us.posthog.com or eu.posthog.com.

name: create_marketing_plan
description: Draft a Delphi marketing plan only. Omit plan_body and Delphi authors the plan from server-side account, performance, and brand research (usually after analyze_brand). Default timeframe is **7 days** (range 1–365, not 30).

name: create_product
description: Manually add a product to the brand catalogue (name, description, optional product page URL). Does not accept image or video bytes.

name: delete_ad_group
description: Permanently remove an ad set / ad group. This cannot be undone.

name: delete_ads
description: Permanently remove one or more ads. This cannot be undone.

name: delete_campaign
description: Permanently remove a paid-media campaign. This cannot be undone.

name: disconnect_google_drive
description: Disconnect the brand's Google Drive OAuth. Revokes the stored connection; Drive can be connected again later.

name: disconnect_posthog
description: Disconnect the brand's PostHog project. Revokes the stored connection; the project can be connected again later.

name: edit_image
description: Edit an existing image with a natural-language prompt. Synchronous; returns the edited image.

name: fetch_product_video_narratives
description: Fetch candidate video narratives (storylines) for a product video before generating it.

name: finalize_scraped_product
description: Commit a scraped product draft into the catalogue with the chosen fields and images. Requires at least one image URL; zero images does not save. Not upsert_brand_product (that leaves a scraped draft).

name: generate_avatar_video_ad
description: Use this when the user wants a talking-head (UGC-style) avatar video ad: a person on screen speaking a short line about the brand or product. Returns job_id.

name: generate_image_ad
description: Queue an on-brand image ad generation job for a brand. Credit-gated; returns a job_id to poll with get_generation_status.

name: generate_multiple_variations_ads
description: Queue one or more still-ad variations (capped at 3). Cost is per still at the chosen resolution (aspect ratios × variations × separate user assets). Returns job_ids.

name: generate_new_clone_video_ad
description: Queue a clone of a winning brand-library video. Use only video_url from list_ad_instance_items (clone_video_allowed true). Confirm 4-30s via get_video_metadata. Pass user_answers_for_cloning from clone_video_pre_assessment.

name: generate_product_video
description: Queue a multi-scene product video ad from a chosen narrative. Credit-gated; returns a job_id to poll with get_generation_status.

name: generate_professional_video_ad
description: Queue a short or long commercial video. Cost scales with target_duration (omit for the 10-second default). Returns job_id. No progress widget — poll get_generation_status with that job_id and kind=video.

name: get_account_credit_balance
description: Use when the user asks how many ad credits remain or whether they can start another branded ad or product video. Returns credit_balance and usd_per_credit.

name: get_ad_custom_properties
description: Custom conversion / property definitions available on the brand for launch or reporting.

name: get_ad_groups
description: List ad sets / ad groups under a campaign (targeting, budget, status). Typically scoped with campaign_id (and ad_group_ids when known). An unscoped brand-wide list may return status=timeout.

name: get_ads
description: List ads in an ad set (creative, status, destination).

name: get_billing_summary
description: Company plan, Stripe customer/subscription flags, and prepaid credit snapshot for the signed-in account. Account-level — not brand ROAS or campaign spend. Does not start a plan change or open the Customer Portal.

name: get_brand
description: Fetch one Omneky brand record by id (name, company, basic fields).

name: get_brand_details
description: Fetch brand identity used for ads: logo, colors, copy, company_id, and creative assets.

name: get_campaign_ad_group_names
description: Name lookup for campaigns and ad groups — useful when matching user language to ids.

name: get_campaigns
description: List paid-media campaigns for a brand and channel (Meta/Facebook, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, OpenAI Ads, X Ads via channel='twitter'). Each row includes campaign id with the name, plus status and budget.

name: get_channel_budget
description: Current allocated daily budget (not spend) for paid-media channels on the brand. Channel totals plus per-campaign breakdown and basis when the backend returns them.

name: get_channel_connect_url
description: OAuth / self-connect URL for an ad channel (facebook, google, linkedin, tiktok, reddit, twitter, pinterest). Wire name for X Ads is twitter, never x. After the user finishes consent, list_authorized_ad_accounts then link_ad_channel_account.

name: get_channel_connection_status
description: Whether the brand's Meta/Facebook, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Pinterest, X Ads (twitter), or OpenAI Ads account is connected and launchable. Pass channel="openai" for OpenAI Ads.

name: get_company
description: Signed-in company's identity and subscription fields (name, plan type, Stripe customer/subscription flags). Does not include the prepaid credit snapshot.

name: get_credit_history
description: Recent company credit grants and usage as JSON rows (capped at 200). Wraps the Nexus credit-history CSV export. Does not return the current balance snapshot and does not change the plan.

name: get_current_user
description: Return the signed-in Omneky user's identity from the session JWT (user_id, email, company). The server already sets user_id and company_id on brand-scoped calls — do not pass them.

name: get_daily_metrics
description: Return a calendar-day paid-media time series for one brand. Required: brand_id from list_brands (calls without it return invalid_argument).

name: get_generation_status
description: Use when the user asks whether an existing image or video job is ready and you already have job_id. Pass kind image or video when you know which; auto probes both and can briefly return not_found before a video row exists. Call once per ask.

name: get_google_drive_connect_url
description: Google Drive OAuth URL for the brand. The user opens it in the browser; this tool does not exchange the callback code.

name: get_google_drive_connection_status
description: Whether the brand has connected Google Drive (no tokens).

name: get_hubspot_connection_status
description: Whether the brand has a connected HubSpot portal (hub / portal id only — never OAuth tokens). No connect or disconnect tool exists on this surface.

name: get_managed_launch_payment_status
description: Peek at prepaid payment status after an Omneky-managed Meta or OpenAI launch returned status=payment_required. Does not launch the campaign and does not start a new charge.

name: get_marketing_plan
description: Fetch a shared-service marketing plan: version, analysis, and step status. Each step is {tool, arguments, depends_on, status}. tool is a public tools/list name. Read-only. Not the CGP chat-agent get_marketing_plan.

name: get_marketing_plan_run
description: Poll a leftover marketing-plan run by run_id (started outside this surface). Status: queued → running → succeeded / failed / cancelled / paused. Unrun steps show pending. Progress of steps you ran lives on get_marketing_plan.

name: get_openai_ads_connection_status
description: Whether the brand has a connected OpenAI Ads account (account name / last-four only — never the API key). To connect, call connect_openai_ads.

name: get_payment_method_summary
description: Card on file for the company (brand, last4, expiry only — never the PAN). Does not collect a new card number.

name: get_performance_breakdown
description: Ranked paid-media breakdown by a dimension — creative, campaign, ad set, ad, channel, or similar — with spend, ROAS, CTR, and conversions. Use for 'which ads/campaigns are winning'. date_range is two inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates, [start, end].

name: get_performance_movers
description: What rose or fell versus the prior period for a brand's paid-media metrics (spend, ROAS, CTR, conversions, and similar). Pass end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and period_days (default 7). Do not send date_range.

name: get_pinterest_ad_groups
description: List Pinterest ad groups. Pass campaign_id when known. Same as get_ad_groups(channel='pinterest').

name: get_pinterest_ads
description: List Pinterest ads (promoted Pins). Same as get_ads(channel='pinterest').

name: get_pinterest_campaigns
description: List Pinterest campaigns for a brand. Same as get_campaigns(channel='pinterest').

name: get_pinterest_connection_status
description: Whether the brand has a connected Pinterest ad account. Same check as get_channel_connection_status(channel='pinterest').

name: get_posthog_connection_status
description: Whether the brand has a connected PostHog project (host / project_id only — never API keys). To connect, call connect_posthog.

name: get_product_details
description: Full catalogue record for one product: name, description, images, and URL. Ground a product-specific ad or video in this data.

name: get_recommendations
description: AI creative / media recommendations for a brand based on recent paid-media performance. Requires brand_id. start_date and end_date are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD; omit both for the last 30 days. A longer window is capped at 30 days.

name: get_semrush_connection_status
description: Whether the brand has a connected Semrush account (last-four only — never the API key). Call this directly; Semrush is not in list_connector_statuses. No connect or disconnect tool on this surface.

name: get_semrush_domain_overview
description: Live Semrush Domain Overview for one hostname and regional database (default us). Nexus enforces daily unit quotas (HTTP 429 = cap / units exhausted).

name: get_semrush_keyword_overview
description: Live Semrush Keyword Overview (volume, CPC, competition, intent). Unit quotas enforced by Nexus (HTTP 429 / 503).

name: get_tiktok_location_ids
description: Resolve TikTok location ids required on TikTok ad-group targeting. Pass required campaign_objective (examples: TRAFFIC, CONVERSIONS, VIDEO_VIEWS; LEADS before a leads launch). TikTok launches need this pre-call or the API returns 400.

name: get_video_metadata
description: Probe duration of a brand-library video before cloning. Pass video_url from list_ad_instance_items only. Returns duration, rounded_duration_seconds, and clone_video_allowed (true when rounded duration is 4-30s). Does not deduct.

name: hubspot_get_company
description: Fetch one HubSpot company by id after hubspot_search_companies.

name: hubspot_get_contact
description: Fetch one HubSpot contact by id after hubspot_search_contacts.

name: hubspot_get_deal
description: Fetch one HubSpot deal by id after hubspot_search_deals.

name: hubspot_search_companies
description: Search HubSpot companies for the brand via Nexus (live CRM). Default page size 10, cap 100.

name: hubspot_search_contacts
description: Search HubSpot contacts for the brand via Nexus (live CRM). Default page size 10, cap 100. Skips when the portal is disconnected.

name: hubspot_search_deals
description: Search HubSpot deals for the brand via Nexus (live CRM). Default page size 10, cap 100.

name: identify_product_from_url
description: Use when the user pastes a product URL or PDP to import into the catalogue before making an ad. Classifies a single product page versus a listing or category. is_single_product false means do not scrape; ask for one product URL.

name: launch_facebook_awareness_ad
description: Create a live paid Meta / Facebook / Instagram brand-awareness / reach campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Meta/Facebook account.

name: launch_facebook_leads_ad
description: Create a live paid Meta / Facebook / Instagram lead-generation campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Meta/Facebook account.

name: launch_facebook_sales_ad
description: Create a live paid Meta / Facebook / Instagram sales / conversions (purchases, ROAS) campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Meta/Facebook account.

name: launch_facebook_traffic_ad
description: Create a live paid Meta / Facebook / Instagram traffic / landing-page clicks campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Meta/Facebook account.

name: launch_facebook_video_views_ad
description: Create a live paid Meta / Facebook / Instagram video-views / ThruPlay campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Meta/Facebook account.

name: launch_google_demand_gen_ad
description: Create a live paid Google Ads Demand Gen (YouTube / Gmail / Discover) campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Google account.

name: launch_google_performance_max_ad
description: Create a live paid Google Ads Performance Max (PMax / Shopping+) campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Google account.

name: launch_linkedin_brand_awareness_ad
description: Create a live paid LinkedIn brand-awareness campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected LinkedIn account.

name: launch_linkedin_conversions_ad
description: Create a live paid LinkedIn conversions / ROAS-style campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected LinkedIn account.

name: launch_linkedin_engagement_ad
description: Create a live paid LinkedIn engagement (reactions, comments, followers) campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected LinkedIn account.

name: launch_linkedin_website_visits_ad
description: Create a live paid LinkedIn website-visits / traffic campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected LinkedIn account.

name: launch_omneky_managed_meta_ad
description: Create a live paid Meta / Facebook / Instagram campaign that spends prepaid budget on Omneky's own ad account and page when the brand has no connected Meta account.

name: launch_omneky_managed_openai_ad
description: Create a live paid OpenAI Ads campaign that spends prepaid budget on Omneky's OpenAI Ads account when the brand has no connected OpenAI Ads account.

name: launch_openai_clicks_ad
description: Create a live paid OpenAI Ads / ChatGPT ads clicks (bidding_type=clicks / chat_card image) campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected OpenAI Ads account.

name: launch_openai_impressions_ad
description: Create a live paid OpenAI Ads / ChatGPT ads impressions (bidding_type=impressions / chat_card image) campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected OpenAI Ads account.

name: launch_pinterest_awareness_ad
description: Create a live paid Pinterest brand-awareness / Pin impressions campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Pinterest account.

name: launch_pinterest_leads_ad
description: Create a live paid Pinterest lead-generation campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Pinterest account.

name: launch_pinterest_sales_ad
description: Create a live paid Pinterest sales / conversions campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Pinterest account.

name: launch_pinterest_traffic_ad
description: Create a live paid Pinterest consideration / traffic campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Pinterest account.

name: launch_pinterest_video_views_ad
description: Create a live paid Pinterest video-completion / video-views campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Pinterest account.

name: launch_reddit_awareness_ad
description: Create a live paid Reddit awareness / reach campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Reddit account.

name: launch_reddit_conversions_ad
description: Create a live paid Reddit conversions campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Reddit account.

name: launch_reddit_leads_ad
description: Create a live paid Reddit lead-generation campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Reddit account.

name: launch_reddit_traffic_ad
description: Create a live paid Reddit traffic / clicks campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Reddit account.

name: launch_reddit_video_views_ad
description: Create a live paid Reddit video-views campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected Reddit account.

name: launch_tiktok_conversions_ad
description: Create a live paid TikTok conversions / ROAS campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected TikTok account.

name: launch_tiktok_leads_ad
description: Create a live paid TikTok lead-generation campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected TikTok account.

name: launch_tiktok_traffic_ad
description: Create a live paid TikTok traffic / clicks campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected TikTok account.

name: launch_tiktok_video_views_ad
description: Create a live paid TikTok video-views / ThruPlay-style campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected TikTok account.

name: launch_twitter_awareness_ad
description: Create a live paid X Ads / Twitter reach / awareness campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected X/Twitter account.

name: launch_twitter_engagements_ad
description: Create a live paid X Ads / Twitter engagements (likes, replies, retweets) campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected X/Twitter account.

name: launch_twitter_followers_ad
description: Create a live paid X Ads / Twitter followers / profile follows campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected X/Twitter account.

name: launch_twitter_traffic_ad
description: Create a live paid X Ads / Twitter website clicks / traffic campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected X/Twitter account.

name: launch_twitter_video_views_ad
description: Create a live paid X Ads / Twitter video-views campaign that spends budget for the signed-in brand. Writes Campaign → Ad Set (ad_group) → Ad on the connected X/Twitter account.

name: link_ad_channel_account
description: Attach an authorized ad account (and Facebook Page when needed) to the brand after OAuth. Wire name for X Ads is twitter, never x. OpenAI Ads uses connect_openai_ads, not this tool.

name: list_ad_instance_items
description: Brand ad library page (video or image). Returns rows with video_url when a preview key exists and clone_video_allowed when that clip can be cloned. Use those video_url values only — not arbitrary public video links.

name: list_authorized_ad_accounts
description: Ad accounts the user authorized on a channel after OAuth (no tokens). Then link_ad_channel_account. Wire name for X Ads is twitter, never x.

name: list_authorized_facebook_pages
description: Facebook Pages the brand authorized (ids and names only — never tokens). Facebook ads need a page id on link_ad_channel_account.

name: list_available_plans
description: Use when the user asks which Omneky plans exist. Returns the six plan lookup keys only (cgp_standard_monthly, cgp_pro_yearly, and the other cgp_* monthly/yearly keys). Read-only; does not change the plan.

name: list_avatar_filters
description: Valid filter values for search_avatars (avatar type, gender, age group, ethnicity, clothing style). Same options for every brand.

name: list_brand_products
description: Use when the user asks to list products, show the catalogue, or pick a product before a branded image ad or product video ad. Returns name, id, and thumbnails when brand_id is numeric.

name: list_brands
description: Use when the signed-in user needs to pick an advertising brand before a branded ad, product video, catalogue list, or performance question and brand_id is not already chosen. Returns id, name, and company.

name: list_connector_statuses
description: Connection status for ad channels (including Pinterest and twitter) plus HubSpot, Ahrefs, OpenAI Ads, PostHog, Google Drive, and other OTB connectors. Never returns tokens.

name: list_marketing_plans
description: List a brand's saved marketing plans, most recently updated first, with each plan_id, title and status. Read only. Use the plan_id with get_marketing_plan, revise_marketing_plan or preview_marketing_plan_execution.

name: list_voices
description: Stock and cloned voices for a brand. Pass a result voice_id to generate_avatar_video_ad. After clone_voice, the new voice appears under cloned_voices — verify it there before saying it speaks in that voice.

name: minimum_budget_for_objective
description: Channel-specific minimum daily/lifetime budget for an objective (sales, traffic, awareness, leads, …).

name: openai_location_search
description: Search OpenAI Ads geo locations for optional campaign targeting. Each result includes a campaign_spec_fragment to paste into campaign_spec.targeting on launch_ad (channel='openai').

name: preview_marketing_plan_execution
description: Read-only ordered checklist of plan steps plus each step's credit quote from Omneky pricing. No side effects: no generation, launch, deduct, or persisted preview token.

name: reach_estimate
description: Estimated audience reach for a targeting spec before launch. Pass brand_id, channel, and targeting_fragments. Not live delivery or ROAS.

name: register_creative_for_launch
description: Persist a chat-generated creative into Ad Central so a later launch_* can attach it as an ad.

name: resize_ad
description: Resize a finished ad to another aspect ratio with AI outpainting. Synchronous.

name: resize_image
description: Resize an image to fit target pixel dimensions. Synchronous.

name: revise_marketing_plan
description: Use this when the user wants to change an existing marketing plan (scope, budget, dates, channels or steps), or after you ran one of the plan's steps and need to mark it done.

name: scrape_product_from_url
description: Import a product page into a catalogue draft (images, name, description). Completing the import uses finalize_scraped_product. May return status=pending; a later call with the same brand_id and url reuses the in-flight Central draft.

name: search_ad_targeting
description: Search targeting facets (locations, interests, …). Required for LinkedIn launches (types=['locations']); also useful for other channels.

name: search_avatars
description: Search the avatar library. Pass a result portrait_url as avatar_url or person_image_url on generate_avatar_video_ad. A brand-asset image of a person who has consented also works.

name: search_google_countries
description: Resolve Google Ads country targeting fragments for Demand Gen (targeting_fragments).

name: search_reporting_values
description: Search campaign, ad set, ad, creative, or other dimension values (name or id) for a brand so later analytics calls can filter. Returns labels, not metrics. Filter operators are includes or excludes only.

name: set_ad_budget
description: Replace the live daily or lifetime budget on an existing Meta/Facebook or Google campaign or ad set. This overwrites the current budget. Facebook: CBO vs ABO — the accepted level depends on how the campaign is configured.

name: set_ad_entity_status
description: Pause, enable, or resume a campaign, ad set, or ad on a connected paid-media channel. Enabling or resuming starts paid delivery and spends budget.

name: set_pinterest_entity_status
description: Pause or resume a live Pinterest campaign, ad group, or ad. Same as set_ad_entity_status for channel='pinterest'.

name: update_ad_targeting
description: Replace targeting on an existing Meta/Facebook ad set (geo, age, or other audience fields). Omitted fields revert to platform defaults — this overwrites the current audience. Facebook-only; not TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, or Reddit.

name: update_product_url
description: Replace the stored product page URL on an existing catalogue item.

name: upsert_brand_product
description: Create or update a completed catalogue product. Without product_id this creates; with product_id it overwrites existing name/description (always sent) and any optional fields you pass.
